name: LazySusanMenu
job: Present dishes or products on a turntable viewed from above that rotates the chosen item to the front with its label and price
visitor_action: drag or swipe to spin; tap an item to bring it forward; arrows rotate step by step
mobile: smaller table, swipe to spin, label under the plate
motion: inertial spin with eased snap to nearest item; wood grain turns under a fixed candle so ring crests flash as they cross the light lobe; plates counter-rotate to stay upright while their shadows, glaze highlights and warm pool follow the candle; candle flame and pool flicker (paused off-screen); reduced-motion: step change with no spin or flicker
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Candlelit banquet table photographed from above: turned walnut turntable with eccentric growth rings, anisotropic grain sheen and a machined brass rim and spindle, ceramic plates with rim highlights and shadows cast away from a single candle, on dark linen; ivory place card across the table edge in DM Serif Display
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5). Fixed plate position bug (plates were rotated twice). Material pass done blind from the gallery screenshot (no render run), so wood-texture contrast, sheen strength and the 1080px+ candle/tumbler props need one look in the browser. Fling friction and snap spring were tuned without a live pass; the inertial feel may need one calibration round. | 2026-11-23: QA nit fixes. Plate photo well enlarged (inset 18%->8%, inside the rim); plaque clamped: name max 3 lines, price one line with ellipsis + title, tighter card/root bottom padding so worst-case root height <= 894px (was 938). Verified in headless Chrome at 900.
